items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: I rehearsed with the Nonet with Miles Davis for four times.

ctx.x: It definitely was a — you had to grab the opportunities when they came, didn’t you?

Yeah. Well I went back to New York after we did the three weeks in Chicago and there was Nola Studios, which was the place to meet. And everybody rehearsed there and so I rehearsed with the Nonet with Miles Davis for four times. It was a good group. I enjoyed it and all that. I came in one day and Kai Winding was there so I said ahh, see you later. So I went down the hall and auditioned for Benny Goodman and I went with the bebop band.
